_comment:
'The next attack action card you play this turn with cost 1 or less gets +1{p}.' Lightning Instant.

Ability type: an Instant CARD whose effect happens when you play it is PLAY, not INSTANT (INSTANT means an activated ability with instant timing - DSL_REFERENCE). This is the exact trap the reference warns about.

Effect: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK add 1 with a filter - verbatim the DSL_REFERENCE example shape, and the same three-condition filter as shipped wtr/nimblism_yellow.json ('next attack with cost 1 or less'). Filter spelling verified against the handlers: ATTACK_COST_LTE reads 'cost' or 'amount' (condition_types.py ~261), ATTACK_TYPE_IN reads 'types' and matches types AND subtypes (~273), ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' (~296). An attack action card is types=['Action'], subtypes=['Attack']; weapon attacks carry type Weapon and do not match, so the three together name precisely 'attack action card'. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK itself reads mod/amount/filter/scope (effect_types.py ~4592) and queues a one-shot entry consumed by the first matching attack this turn; scope defaults to TURN, matching 'this turn'.

Release note followed: 'Base cost is the printed cost value on a card' - _attack_card_cost (condition_types.py ~92) reads exactly that printed cost, so ATTACK_COST_LTE 1 implements 'cost 1 or less' as intended.

No printed keywords. No gaps found.
